rules.quote: Card Track Data must be Track 2
rules.statement: PINless POS magnetic-stripe processing uses Track 2.
rules.condition: Confirmed supported PINless POS network and MSR transaction; not EMV, Signature Debit or a receipt label.

rules.quote: POS PINless transactions are ONLY eligible with the US Common Debit AID as
rules.statement: PINless EMV uses US Common Debit AID.
rules.condition: Section 10.3 EMV PINless profile; No CVM and no PIN Block independently required; AID label is not routing evidence.

rules.quote: Transactions with cashback
rules.statement: PINless POS excludes cashback.
rules.condition: Section 10.3 PINless POS; cashback is explicitly in the exclusions list.

rules.quote: Transactions where the final amount is not known (restaurant with tip, hotels, car rental)
rules.statement: PINless POS requires a known final amount.
rules.condition: Confirmed PINless POS profile; not a universal rule for all debit transactions.

rules.quote: The device does not perform expiration date validation in an EBT card transaction.
rules.statement: EBT does not validate card expiration at the device.
rules.condition: Section 10.5 food/cash EBT profile; expiration prompting is distinct from expiration validation.

rules.quote: For manually entered Account Numbers, the device must also prompt for the card
rules.statement: Manually entered EBT prompts for expiration.
rules.condition: Food/cash EBT account manually keyed; PIN exceptions still governed by transaction type.

rules.quote: If no expiration date is provided, use 1249.
rules.statement: Manual EBT uses 1249 when expiration is unavailable.
rules.condition: Manual food/cash EBT account entry with no provided expiration; value is device-entry MMYY, not Track 2 YYMM.

rules.quote: Balances of zero dollars should only be printed when zero is actually returned as the balance from the authorizer.
rules.statement: EBT omits the balance line when that balance was not returned.
rules.condition: Specified food/cash balance absent in authorizer response; zero returned is a separate valid case.

rules.quote: The device must allow for entry of the Voucher Number from the manual voucher ticket.
rules.statement: Food Stamp Electronic Voucher supports voucher-number entry.
rules.condition: Food Stamp Electronic Voucher, not a standard cash-benefit purchase.

rules.quote: These specifications do not support Return transactions.
rules.statement: eWIC does not support Return.
rules.condition: eWIC profile; Return is distinct from Purchase Reversal/Void and authorization cancellation.

rules.quote: before any additional eWIC transactions can be sent from the device that originated the eWIC Purchase Reversal/Void Request.
rules.statement: eWIC pending reversal response blocks additional transactions.
rules.condition: Device has sent eWIC Purchase Reversal/Void and has not received its response; response code is not required to be approval.

rules.quote: until a Purchase Reversal/Void Response to the eWIC Purchase Reversal/Void Request is received.
rules.statement: eWIC retries unresolved reversal until a response arrives.
rules.condition: No response to Purchase Reversal/Void; earliest-opportunity retry policy, not an invented timeout interval.

rules.quote: A stored value card cannot be used for transactions until it has been activated.
rules.statement: Stored-value use requires activation.
rules.condition: Stored-value purchase/use after a valid activation method; activation transaction itself is not prohibited.

rules.quote: The device does not perform expiration date validation in a stored value card transaction.
rules.statement: Stored value does not validate expiration at device.
rules.condition: Section 10.7 stored-value transaction; issuer approval remains external.

rules.quote: When manual entry is not allowed, and the POS device is unable to read the magnetic stripe after three attempts, a message should be displayed to the clerk, and the transaction ended.
rules.statement: Stored-value failed reads end transaction when authorizer prohibits manual entry.
rules.condition: Authorizer manual-entry prohibition supplied; three failed stripe attempts observed.

rules.quote: Bar Code Scanned Gift card should be treated as a manually entered transaction.
rules.statement: Non-Blackhawk barcode gift-card entry is manual mode 01.
rules.condition: Ordinary barcode-scanned gift card under 10.7.2.2; Blackhawk scanned transactions explicitly excluded.

rules.quote: Blackhawk Gift card transactions should be treated as swiped transactions.
rules.statement: Blackhawk scanned gift-card entry uses mode 90.
rules.condition: Blackhawk scanned transaction; not generic barcode gift cards.

rules.quote: The device does not perform expiration date validation in a loyalty card transaction.
rules.statement: Loyalty does not validate expiration at device.
rules.condition: Section 10.9 loyalty account operation; not underlying payment-card validation.

rules.quote: When no expiration data is present, the device sends a default value of 1249 (MMYY).
rules.statement: Loyalty missing manual expiration uses 1249.
rules.condition: Manually keyed loyalty account with no expiration present on card; MMYY device-entry value.

rules.quote: require MICR data for check processing when swiped data entry is used:
rules.statement: SCAN and TeleCheck swiped checks require MICR.
rules.condition: SCAN (ETC) or ECA/TeleCheck swiped check processing; not a universal rule for all manual checks.

rules.quote: and date of birth for check processing when manual data entry is used:
rules.statement: Certegy manual checks require birth date.
rules.condition: Certegy manually entered check; driver license and State Code required separately.

rules.quote: The check writer must sign the merchant
rules.statement: Approved TeleCheck completion requires customer signature.
rules.condition: Approved ECA/TeleCheck merchant authorization; logical signature observation, not rendered receipt proof.

rules.quote: the Merchant Profile at BUYPASS must have Terminal Special code 091 enabled.
rules.statement: Fleet One profile enables Terminal Special code 091.
rules.condition: Petroleum 2025-1 Fleet One processing; profile enablement evidence supplied, not inferred from card code.

rules.quote: manual entry of the 19-digit Fleet One fleet card Account Number.
rules.statement: Manual Fleet One account has 19 digits.
rules.condition: Fleet One manual-entry fallback after failed reads; expiry default separately required.

rules.quote: The device does not perform expiration date validation in a Fleet One fleet card transaction.
rules.statement: Fleet One device does not validate expiration.
rules.condition: Fleet One card under Petroleum 2025-1; no general-credit inheritance.

rules.quote: Terminal Special Code 080 enabled.
rules.statement: FleetCor profile enables Terminal Special code 080.
rules.condition: Fuelman/Fleetwide FleetCor profile; terminal special code 080 is NOT Mastercard card type 080.

rules.quote: manual entry of the 17-digit FleetCor card Account Number.
rules.statement: Manual FleetCor account has 17 digits.
rules.condition: Fuelman/Fleetwide manual-entry fallback; not Fleet One or WEX.

rules.quote: If no expiration date is embossed on the card, the value 1299 (MMYY) is always entered at the device.
rules.statement: FleetCor absent embossed expiration uses 1299.
rules.condition: Manual Fuelman/Fleetwide entry with no expiration embossed; MMYY, not generic 1249.

rules.quote: one of the entities will take responsibility for storing the transactions.
rules.statement: WEX fleet connection-loss recovery assigns transaction-storage responsibility.
rules.condition: Device-to-BUYPASS or BUYPASS-to-WEX connection lost; exactly which entity owns recovery requires deployment evidence, not COMDATA SAF policy.

rules.quote: Store and Forward is not supported by COMDATA card processing.
rules.statement: COMDATA fleet excludes Store and Forward.
rules.condition: COMDATA chapter 11 card processing, not chapter 14 fuel-price updates.

rules.quote: Terminal Special Code 003 enabled.
rules.statement: Applicable COMDATA processing enables special code 003.
rules.condition: COMDATA program's own chapter repeats special code 003; program enablement and card type remain separate evidence.

rules.quote: prompt for the data specified in the Account Verification response
rules.statement: COMDATA auth prompts follow Account Verification response.
rules.condition: COMDATA Account Verification response supplied and prompts applicable to Authorization Only; format validity separately checked.

rules.quote: The following transaction is supported for Express Code processing (Card Type 095):
rules.statement: COMDATA Express Code uses POS Capture.
rules.condition: Petroleum chapter 12 supported-transaction list contains POS Capture only; not a general COMDATA transaction allowlist.

rules.quote: The following transaction is supported for Check processing (Card Type 096):
rules.statement: COMDATA Check uses POS Authorization Only.
rules.condition: Petroleum chapter 13 supported-transaction list contains POS Authorization Only; not TeleCheck.

rules.quote: only the most recent Fuel Price Update should be retried once connectivity is restored.
rules.statement: COMDATA price-update recovery retries the latest update.
rules.condition: Extended outage with multiple unsent fuel-price updates; do not inherit COMDATA card SAF prohibition.

rules.quote: Manual entry is not allowed for any WEX OTR card.
rules.statement: WEX OTR prohibits manual entry.
rules.condition: WEX OTR card profile, not WEX OTR Money Code.

rules.quote: Any product category not included in the authorization response is considered not allowed.
rules.statement: WEX OTR online excludes unlisted product categories.
rules.condition: Online WEX OTR authorization response supplied; offline Dynamic Card Table policy is separate.

rules.quote: If the approved maximum dollar amount is less than the AFP pump limit, the approved maximum dollar amount takes precedence.
rules.statement: WEX OTR lower approved amount caps pump authorization.
rules.condition: AFP host-approved maximum less than local pump limit; response and both amounts supplied in cents.

rules.quote: All Money Code transactions are entered manually.
rules.statement: WEX Money Code requires manual entry.
rules.condition: Petroleum chapter 16 Money Code, not chapter 15 WEX OTR card.

rules.quote: the expiration date should be skipped.
rules.statement: WEX Money Code skips expiration.
rules.condition: Money Code manually entered in Account Number field; no synthetic default expiry.

rules.quote: No prompt data will be exchanged for Money Code transactions.
rules.statement: WEX Money Code exchanges no prompt data.
rules.condition: Money Code operation under chapter 16; not regular WEX OTR prompts.
